Field Descriptions

RPTR

Read Pointer. Current FIFO read address (0-31). Updated by hardware when FIFO_RDATA is read. Read-only for software.

WPTR

Write Pointer. Current FIFO write address (0-31). Updated by hardware when entropy data is pushed. Read-only for software.

LEVEL

Fill Level. Number of valid 32-bit entropy words currently in FIFO (0-32). Poll this field to determine when data is available for reading. LEVEL=0 means FIFO empty, LEVEL=32 means FIFO full.
